description.en: Start your journey through the cosmos — the Sun, Moon, planets, stars and the wonders in between.
description.hr: Pocetak putovanja kroz kosmos — Sunce, Mjesec, planete, zvijezde i cuda izmedju njih.

front.en: Which planet could float on water?
front.hr: Koja planeta bi plutala na vodi?

back.en: Saturn. It's so low in density it would float in a giant bathtub — it's less dense than water itself.
back.hr: Saturn. Toliko je male gustoce da bi plutao u ogromnoj kadi — manje je gust od same vode.

explanation.en: Saturn's density is about 0.69 g/cm³, while water is 1 g/cm³.
explanation.hr: Gustoca Saturna je oko 0,69 g/cm³, dok je voda 1 g/cm³.

front.en: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
front.hr: Koliko svjetlost sa Sunca putuje do Zemlje?

back.en: About 8 minutes and 20 seconds. When you look at the Sun, you see it as it was 8 minutes ago.
back.hr: Oko 8 minuta i 20 sekundi. Kad gledas Sunce, vidis ga kakvo je bilo prije 8 minuta.

front.en: Supernova

back.en: The explosion of a massive star at the end of its life. Briefly shines brighter than an entire galaxy, and forges elements like gold and iron.
back.hr: Eksplozija masivne zvijezde na kraju zivota. Nakratko zasja jace od cijele galaksije i stvara elemente poput zlata i zeljeza.

explanation.en: The heavy elements in your body were made in supernovae — you're literally made of stardust.
explanation.hr: Teski elementi u tvom tijelu nastali su u supernovama — doslovno si napravljen od zvjezdane prasine.

front.en: How many Earths fit inside the Sun?

back.en: About 1,300,000. The Sun makes up 99.8% of all the mass in the Solar System.
back.hr: Oko 1.300.000. Sunce cini 99,8% ukupne mase Suncevog sistema.

front.en: What is the largest planet in the Solar System?
front.hr: Koja je najveca planeta u Suncevom sistemu?

back.en: Jupiter. It's so big that all other planets combined would fit inside it — twice over.
back.hr: Jupiter. Toliko je velik da bi sve ostale planete zajedno stale u njega — i to dvaput.

front.en: Light-year

back.en: The distance light travels in one year — about 9.46 trillion km. It measures distance, not time.
back.hr: Udaljenost koju svjetlost prijedje za godinu dana — oko 9,46 biliona km. Mjeri udaljenost, ne vrijeme.

explanation.en: The nearest star beyond the Sun, Proxima Centauri, is 4.2 light-years away.
explanation.hr: Najbliza zvijezda poslije Sunca, Proksima Kentauri, udaljena je 4,2 svjetlosne godine.

front.en: Which planet spins on its side?
front.hr: Koja se planeta okrece na boku?

back.en: Uranus. Its axis is tilted about 98°, so it essentially rolls around the Sun like a ball.
back.hr: Uran. Osa mu je nagnuta oko 98°, pa se u biti kotrlja oko Sunca poput lopte.

explanation.en: Likely caused by a massive collision early in its history.
explanation.hr: Vjerovatno posljedica ogromnog sudara rano u njegovoj historiji.

front.en: Why is Mars red?

back.en: Iron oxide — rust. Its surface is covered in iron-rich dust that has literally rusted over billions of years.
back.hr: Zeljezni oksid — hrdja. Povrsina je prekrivena prasinom bogatom zeljezom koja je doslovno zahrdala kroz milijarde godina.

front.en: Black hole

back.en: A region where gravity is so strong that nothing — not even light — can escape once past the edge.
back.hr: Podrucje gdje je gravitacija toliko jaka da nista — ni svjetlost — ne moze pobjeci jednom kad prijedje rub.

explanation.en: That edge is called the event horizon.
explanation.hr: Taj rub se zove horizont dogadjaja.

front.en: How long is a day on Venus compared to its year?
front.hr: Koliko traje dan na Veneri u odnosu na godinu?

back.en: A day on Venus is longer than its year. It rotates so slowly that one spin takes longer than one orbit around the Sun.
back.hr: Dan na Veneri je duzi od njene godine. Rotira toliko sporo da joj jedan okret traje duze od jednog kruga oko Sunca.

front.en: What is the closest planet to the Sun?

back.en: Mercury. Yet it's not the hottest planet — Venus is, thanks to its thick, heat-trapping atmosphere.
back.hr: Merkur. Ipak nije najtoplija planeta — Venera jeste, zbog guste atmosfere koja zadrzava toplinu.

front.en: Galaxy

back.en: A vast system of stars, gas, dust and dark matter bound by gravity. Our galaxy, the Milky Way, holds 100–400 billion stars.
back.hr: Ogroman sistem zvijezda, plina, prasine i tamne materije povezan gravitacijom. Nasa galaksija, Mlijecni put, ima 100–400 milijardi zvijezda.

front.en: Can you hear sound in space?
front.hr: Cuje li se zvuk u svemiru?

back.en: No. Sound needs a medium like air to travel, and space is a near-perfect vacuum. Space is silent.
back.hr: Ne. Zvuku treba sredina poput zraka da bi putovao, a svemir je gotovo savrsen vakuum. Svemir je tih.

front.en: What causes the Moon's phases?

back.en: The changing angle between the Sun, Earth and Moon. We see different portions of the Moon's lit half as it orbits us.
back.hr: Promjenjivi ugao izmedju Sunca, Zemlje i Mjeseca. Vidimo razlicite dijelove osvijetljene polovine Mjeseca dok nas obilazi.

front.en: Comet

back.en: An icy body that grows a glowing tail as it nears the Sun and its ice turns to gas. Often called a 'dirty snowball'.
back.hr: Ledeno tijelo koje dobija sjajni rep kako se priblizava Suncu i led mu prelazi u plin. Cesto zvan 'prljava grudva snijega'.

explanation.en: A comet's tail always points away from the Sun, pushed by solar wind.
explanation.hr: Rep kometa uvijek pokazuje od Sunca, jer ga gura suncev vjetar.

front.en: How far away is the Moon?

back.en: About 384,000 km. All the other planets of the Solar System could fit in the gap between Earth and the Moon.
back.hr: Oko 384.000 km. Sve ostale planete Suncevog sistema stale bi u razmak izmedju Zemlje i Mjeseca.

front.en: What is a shooting star, really?

back.en: Not a star at all — a tiny piece of rock or dust burning up as it enters Earth's atmosphere. Most are no bigger than a grain of sand.
back.hr: Uopste nije zvijezda — sitni komadic stijene ili prasine koji izgara ulazeci u Zemljinu atmosferu. Vecina nije veca od zrna pijeska.

front.en: Constellation

back.en: A recognizable pattern of stars in the night sky. There are 88 official constellations covering the whole sky.
back.hr: Prepoznatljiv uzorak zvijezda na nocnom nebu. Postoji 88 sluzbenih sazvijezdja koja pokrivaju cijelo nebo.

explanation.en: The stars in a constellation usually aren't close together — they just appear aligned from Earth.
explanation.hr: Zvijezde u sazvijezdju obicno nisu blizu jedna drugoj — samo nam se cine poravnate sa Zemlje.

front.en: What is the hottest planet in the Solar System?
front.hr: Koja je najtoplija planeta Suncevog sistema?

back.en: Venus, around 465°C — hot enough to melt lead. Its thick CO₂ atmosphere traps heat in a runaway greenhouse effect.
back.hr: Venera, oko 465°C — dovoljno vruce da otopi olovo. Gusta CO₂ atmosfera zarobljava toplinu u pobjeglom efektu staklenika.

front.en: How many moons does Earth have?

back.en: One permanent Moon. Occasionally small asteroids get temporarily caught in Earth's gravity — nicknamed 'minimoons'.
back.hr: Jedan stalni Mjesec. Povremeno se mali asteroidi privremeno uhvate u Zemljinu gravitaciju — zvani 'mini-mjeseci'.

front.en: Nebula

back.en: A giant cloud of gas and dust in space — often a stellar nursery where new stars are born.
back.hr: Ogroman oblak plina i prasine u svemiru — cesto 'rodiliste zvijezda' gdje nastaju nove zvijezde.

front.en: Which planet has the biggest volcano?

back.en: Mars. Olympus Mons is about 22 km tall — nearly three times the height of Mount Everest.
back.hr: Mars. Olympus Mons je visok oko 22 km — gotovo tri puta visi od Mount Everesta.

front.en: What is the Sun made of?

back.en: Mostly hydrogen (about 74%) and helium (about 24%). It fuses hydrogen into helium, releasing the energy that lights our sky.
back.hr: Uglavnom vodik (oko 74%) i helij (oko 24%). Spaja vodik u helij, oslobadjajuci energiju koja obasjava nase nebo.

front.en: Asteroid

back.en: A rocky leftover from the formation of the Solar System. Most orbit the Sun in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
back.hr: Stjenoviti ostatak od nastanka Suncevog sistema. Vecina kruzi oko Sunca u asteroidnom pojasu izmedju Marsa i Jupitera.

front.en: How old is the Universe?

back.en: About 13.8 billion years. If that were compressed into one year, humans would appear only in the last few minutes of December 31.
back.hr: Oko 13,8 milijardi godina. Kad bi to sabili u jednu godinu, ljudi bi se pojavili tek u zadnjih par minuta 31. decembra.

front.en: Why do stars twinkle?

back.en: Their light bends as it passes through Earth's moving atmosphere. Above the atmosphere, stars shine steadily. Planets twinkle far less.
back.hr: Njihova svjetlost se lomi prolazeci kroz Zemljinu pokretnu atmosferu. Iznad atmosfere zvijezde sjaje mirno. Planete trepere puno manje.

front.en: Orbit

back.en: The curved path one object takes around another due to gravity — like Earth around the Sun, or the Moon around Earth.
back.hr: Zakrivljena putanja jednog tijela oko drugog zbog gravitacije — kao Zemlja oko Sunca, ili Mjesec oko Zemlje.

front.en: What are Saturn's rings made of?

back.en: Billions of pieces of ice and rock, from tiny grains to house-sized chunks. Despite their width, they're only about 10 metres thick on average.
back.hr: Milijarde komada leda i stijene, od sitnih zrna do komada velicine kuce. Uprkos sirini, u prosjeku su debeli samo oko 10 metara.

front.en: What is the Milky Way?

back.en: Our home galaxy — a barred spiral of hundreds of billions of stars. On dark nights you can see its band arching across the sky.
back.hr: Nasa domaca galaksija — spiralna s precagom, s stotinama milijardi zvijezda. Za tamnih noci vidis njen pojas kako se luči preko neba.

front.en: Gravity

back.en: The force that pulls objects with mass toward each other. It holds planets in orbit, shapes galaxies, and keeps your feet on the ground.
back.hr: Sila koja privlaci tijela s masom jedno prema drugom. Drzi planete u orbiti, oblikuje galaksije i drzi ti stopala na tlu.

front.en: Which is the smallest planet?

back.en: Mercury — barely larger than our Moon. A year there lasts just 88 Earth days.
back.hr: Merkur — jedva veci od naseg Mjeseca. Godina tamo traje samo 88 zemaljskih dana.

front.en: What is the International Space Station?

back.en: A crewed laboratory orbiting Earth at about 400 km, circling the planet roughly every 90 minutes — 16 sunrises a day.
back.hr: Laboratorija s posadom koja kruzi oko Zemlje na oko 400 km, obilazi planetu otprilike svakih 90 minuta — 16 izlazaka sunca dnevno.

front.en: Dwarf planet

back.en: A world that orbits the Sun and is round, but hasn't cleared its orbital neighbourhood. Pluto is the most famous example.
back.hr: Svijet koji kruzi oko Sunca i okrugao je, ali nije 'ocistio' svoju orbitu. Pluton je najpoznatiji primjer.

explanation.en: Pluto was reclassified from planet to dwarf planet in 2006.
explanation.hr: Pluton je 2006. preklasificiran iz planete u patuljastu planetu.

front.en: How many stars can you see with the naked eye?

back.en: Around 2,000–3,000 on a very dark night from one spot — a tiny fraction of the billions in our galaxy alone.
back.hr: Oko 2.000–3.000 za jako tamne noci s jednog mjesta — sitni djelic milijardi u samo nasoj galaksiji.

front.en: Why does the Moon always show the same face?
front.hr: Zasto nam Mjesec uvijek pokazuje isto lice?

back.en: Tidal locking. The Moon rotates exactly once per orbit, so the same side always faces Earth. The 'far side' isn't dark — it just faces away.
back.hr: Plimno zakljucavanje. Mjesec se okrene tacno jednom po orbiti, pa nam je uvijek okrenuta ista strana. 'Druga strana' nije tamna — samo je okrenuta od nas.

front.en: Solar eclipse

back.en: When the Moon passes between the Sun and Earth, casting its shadow and briefly blocking the Sun.
back.hr: Kad Mjesec prodje izmedju Sunca i Zemlje, bacajuci sjenu i nakratko zakrivajuci Sunce.

explanation.en: By cosmic coincidence, the Sun and Moon appear almost the same size in our sky.
explanation.hr: Kosmickom slucajnoscu, Sunce i Mjesec izgledaju gotovo iste velicine na nasem nebu.

front.en: What is the largest known star?

back.en: Stephenson 2-18. If placed where our Sun is, it would swallow the orbit of Saturn. Our Sun is a dot beside it.
back.hr: Stephenson 2-18. Kad bi bila na mjestu naseg Sunca, progutala bi orbitu Saturna. Nase Sunce je tackica pored nje.

front.en: What holds the planets in orbit around the Sun?
front.hr: Sta drzi planete u orbiti oko Sunca?

back.en: The Sun's immense gravity. Its mass bends space itself, and the planets travel along that curve.
back.hr: Ogromna gravitacija Sunca. Njegova masa savija sam prostor, a planete putuju tom zakrivljenoscu.

front.en: Meteor shower

back.en: When Earth passes through the debris trail left by a comet, producing many shooting stars in one night.
back.hr: Kad Zemlja prodje kroz trag krhotina koji je ostavio komet, stvarajuci mnogo zvijezda padalica u jednoj noci.

explanation.en: The Perseids each August are one of the most reliable and popular showers.
explanation.hr: Perseidi svakog avgusta su jedan od najpouzdanijih i najpopularnijih rojeva.

front.en: How long would it take to drive to the Sun?
front.hr: Koliko bi trebalo da se autom stigne do Sunca?

back.en: At highway speed (100 km/h), about 170 years non-stop. Space distances are almost impossible to grasp.
back.hr: Brzinom autoceste (100 km/h), oko 170 godina bez zaustavljanja. Svemirske udaljenosti je gotovo nemoguce pojmiti.
